roster.invocation: Real API call via tools/call_openai.mjs, POST /v1/chat/completions, one call per batch
roster.temperature: omitted (not sent) — some gpt-5.x models reject a nonzero value when reasoning_effort is set; leaving unset is the honestly-disclosed setting, not a claimed nominal value
roster.reasoning_effort: "none" — the minimum value gpt-5.5 accepts (verified live 2026-07-28; this model's valid set is none/low/medium/high/xhigh, a different scale than earlier gpt-5 ids which used minimal/low/medium/high)
roster.tools: no tools, no structured-output/response-format mode; same bare instruction-based JSON-array protocol as every other roster entry

roster.invocation: Real API call via tools/call_gemini.mjs, POST generateContent, one call per batch
roster.temperature: omitted (not sent) — no generationConfig override; nominal defaults, not independently verified as "minimal," disclosed as such rather than assumed
roster.reasoning_effort: not exposed by this model's API in the fields this harness sends; no thinking-budget override applied
roster.tools: no tools, no structured-output/response-schema mode; same bare instruction-based JSON-array protocol as every other roster entry. NOTE: this is a preview model — it can change behavior or be deprecated without notice; it was the only Gemini model this account's key could call as of 2026-07-28 (gemini-2.5-* rejected as unavailable to new users, gemini-2.0-flash had zero free-tier quota).

settings_notes: Uniform protocol arm only (§2.5): minimum reasoning/thinking settings across the roster; an as-deployed arm starts with the first multi-vendor wave.
Temperature is not exposed by the Claude Code subagent harness (deviation (2)); OpenAI and Gemini arms omit temperature entirely rather than claim a nominal value not independently verified.

The platform's own system prompt is vendor-controlled and not publishable for the Claude arm — disclosed limitation, METHODOLOGY §7 deviation (1); full harness prompt texts and raw outputs are published verbatim for every vendor.

R1 reuses P0's question bank and batch assignment verbatim (questions/R1.json = questions/P0.json; questions/R1-batches.json's `batches` array is identical to P0's). Ground truth was refrozen fresh under snapshots/R1/ rather than reused from P0, since served values can revise between freezes.

R1-batches.json's model_order for gpt-5.5 and gemini-3-flash-preview was computed from the exact same documented formula as P0's 4 Claude entries (shuffle(qids, rngFromHex(deriveSeed(seed, "{model}:{batch_id}")))), not a fresh draw or hand-picked order. Verified before use: recomputing all 4 existing Claude orders from this formula reproduced P0's frozen file byte-for-byte.
R1 satisfies COVENANT §6 (>=2 non-Anthropic vendors: OpenAI and Google, alongside Anthropic/Claude) — the first roster in this benchmark eligible to produce a citable cross-model result.

P0 results remain quarantined per METHODOLOGY §7: methodology validation only, never citable as a finding about Claude or about AI. R1 is a distinct run with its own manifest and its own citability status.
